steps.title: Collect complete assistant text
steps.explanation: Complete text blocks are projected independently of partial deltas. The browser then renders this complete-text buffer in its own formatted panel.
steps.narration: Step eleven collects complete assistant text separately. The observer sets text block rather than text delta. This distinction lets the browser format both views without appending the complete message into the streamed-text buffer again.
